summary: Join our comprehensive training course to master the techniques for monitoring the effectiveness of social protection investments and drive impactful change.
lede: Monitoring social protection investments helps program managers, public officials, evaluators, and development partners assess who programs reach and what results they produce. This course covers building results frameworks and indicators, using administrative data, surveys, and beneficiary feedback, analyzing performance and costs, and turning evidence into program and budget decisions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who regularly oversee, fund, or manage social protection investments and need to understand their effectiveness.
audience: Social protection program managers and coordinators
Government officials in ministries of social development
Social protection information system and data managers
Social policy researchers and analysts in think
modules: Foundations of Social Protection and Effectiveness Thinking
Building Results Frameworks for Social Protection Investments
Indicators and Measurement for Social Protection Outcomes
Data Systems and Sources for Monitoring Social Protection
Value for Money and Cost Effectiveness in Social Protection
Equity, Inclusion, and Leaving No One Behind
Using Evaluations and Deep Dives to Complement Monitoring
Risks, Biases, and Pitfalls in Interpreting Evidence
Communicating Results and Driving Policy Change
prerequisites: Participants should have a basic understanding of social protection concepts and familiarity with monitoring and evaluation processes. Prior experience in managing or overseeing social protection programs will be beneficial.
